messages:
Alex M: Quick async standup for release train — noon cut window. TL;DR: on track but seeing a flaky e2e in prometheus exporter on some mac-runner images. Plan below, please ack.

Priya K: Which PRs need cherry-picks? I can take backports.

Sam R: I'll start the canary for 3.14.2 once CI green. Two PRs to watch: #4826 (retry logic) and #4839 (metrics labels).

Taylor C: FYI the e2e flake is a port bind race on mac runners, I can repro locally with docker. Investigating root cause now.

Jordan L: Blocking for QA: we saw p99 timeout regressions for long-sequence inference when batching heuristic hits edge-case. Might be related to #4826.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated for rev e3c4a (build 789). View: https://ci.internal/build/789

Alex M: Plan: Priya to cherry-pick #4839 to release/3.14; Sam to monitor canary; Taylor to dig into mac-runner flake; Jordan to triage timeout regression. If anything blocks, @eng-releases and flag priority.

Priya K: :thumbsup: I'll do the cherry-pick now. ETA ~30m. Commands I'm using:
```bash
git checkout release/3.14
git cherry-pick -x 1a2b3c4  # cherry-pick metrics labels
git push origin release/3.14
```

Sam R: CI mostly green on main but got intermittent runner timeouts on e2e. Rerunning flaky job now.

Taylor C: Found repro: ipv6 binding race with ephemeral ports on mac VM overlay. Pushed a local fix branch fix/ipv6-bind, prepping PR.

Jordan L: For timeout regression I added a metric and temporarily reverted the new batching heuristic on one canary to compare. Will update by EOD with numbers.

Alex M: If revert is needed we have fallback to model-variant with older batching. Also add release-note blurb about metrics label change and potential flake. @Priya can you add that line?

Priya K: Added a line in draft release notes: "metrics labels updated; potential e2e flake on mac workers under load" — see PR #4851.

Sam R: Canary at 10% traffic now. p50/p95 look stable, no error-rate spike so far. Will move to 30% in 15m if stable.

Taylor C: Infra PR posted: #4860. Marking as backport candidate for the release branch.

Priya K: Cherry-picks applied: release/3.14 includes #4839 and queued #4860 backport. Triggered backport CI and tags pushed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout at 30% complete for rev e3c4a — no errors reported. duration=25m

Alex M: Good progress. Current open blockers: QA timeout triage (Jordan) and confirm mac runner flake fixed (Taylor). Everyone pls ping if you need an immediate rollback. Thanks all.

Sam R: Noted. I'll keep watch on canary metrics and call rollback if error-rate > 0.5% for 5m.

Priya K: Closing loop on cherry-picks. Will follow up with release notes and a short postmortem if flake persists.
